verdict.rationale: Docusign offers an official MCP server and a supported Claude connector, plus Gemini CLI pairing, for querying agreement status, retrieving metadata, and triggering workflow actions in natural language through AI clients. Its in-product AI-powered chat and Q&A cover agreement review, redlining, and drafting rather than general product operation. Natural-language control works mainly through external LLM clients, and the documented action scope looks narrow, which is why this is partial rather than full. Missing for 10: native in-product natural-language command interface for core operations like sending and managing envelopes, evidence that MCP tools cover full send/sign/manage actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
